merged_file.note: Canonical merged schema. Route files (venue_audit_YYYY_YYYY.jsonl) remain in the same directory with full per-route detail (evidence objects, name-variant notes, rename notes); merged rows point to them via route_file. Kickoff/timezone/round/meeting-number/team values are copied verbatim from the baseline and were not modified; meeting_number itself is not repeated in the merged file because the request asked for venue fields plus the crosswalk only (record_key + provider_fixture_id join back to the baseline for meeting_number).

Adjudicated to Lerkendal with Abrahallen retained as a competing candidate in-row. This is an adjudication, not official confirmation.

coordinate_coverage.rows_with_coords: 1919/1920 (the single conflict row has null coordinates; both competing grounds' coordinates are in the route coordinate table, not assigned to the row)
coordinate_coverage.venue_strings: 49 distinct verified (name, city) strings in the merged file. This is a spelling-variant count (case, ae/oe/aa transliteration, locality-vs-municipality city spellings, sponsor renames), NOT 49 physical grounds. Routes each report 18 physical sites per two-season block; physical grounds across 8 seasons are the union of club grounds for 24 distinct home clubs plus the 2 neutral grounds (Intility Arena, Aker stadion), with sponsor renames counted once.
coordinate_coverage.coordinate_sources: OpenStreetMap Nominatim search JSON (venue-level, not per-fixture confirmation). Byte-captured JSON with recomputed SHA-256 for most venues; exceptions in the unresolved queue (D-route 3 sites via map tool, sha null; FBref text-layer evidence sha null).
coordinate_coverage.baseline_coordinate_discrepancy: Sandefjord/Jotun Arena: baseline (59.17544, 10.21542) vs Nominatim venue point (59.1371935, 10.1795249), 4.72 km apart. Three independent routes agree the Nominatim point matches the published ground address/coordinates and the baseline point reverse-geocodes to a residential address (Sondre Kullerod). Both values are preserved in-row; the Nominatim point is adopted for venue_lat/venue_lon. All other venues: baseline vs Nominatim within 0.6 km (street-level take-point differences, e.g. Brann 341 m, Sarpsborg 595 m, Nadderud 233 m), recorded as precision notes, not identity conflicts.

naming_and_renames: All source spellings are preserved in-row (source_venue_name, venue_candidates, route notes). Normalisation was used only to judge same-physical-ground: Alfheim=Romssa Arena (renamed 2023-03-29); Isachsen=Consto Arena; Ranheim Arena=EXTRA Arena; SR-Bank Arena=Viking Stadion=Lyse Arena (Lyse from 2025); Sor Arena=Sparebanken Sor Arena=Sparebanken Norge Arena; Kristiansund Stadion=Nordmore stadion; Komplett.no Arena (to 2019-11) -> Release Arena (2021-05-05) -> Jotun Arena (2023-09-05); Haugesund Stadion -> Haugesund Sparebank Arena (2021-05; clean mid-season split in baseline: Stadion to 2021-07-18, Sparebank Arena from 2021-07-28; announcement date unverified); Sarpsborg st KG = Sarpsborg Stadion artificial-turf pitch (not a different ground, not moved). FBref tables use expired sponsor names in several seasons; verified names use the matchday-current name.
exclusions_verified: No 2026 fixtures; no odds, scores, results, post-match status, standings (final or pre-kickoff), Qimen/palace/stem/door/star/deity/five-element interpretation, prediction, probability, Snapshot, Outcome, Review, or Gold fields in the merged file (field-name scan: 0 hits). No true solar time was calculated. No local Qimen project files were written. No purchase, no login, no credential, no API-Football paid-quota use.
method_honesty: FBref per-fixture Venue values were read from full season tables (240/240 per season where used); where a route reports 'team-season constant venue', that constancy was observed after reading the full table, not assumed from a club stadium list. Verified city values come from the baseline where the per-fixture source table has no city column (FBref, NFF Bane column); this is stated on the rows/notes and city is weaker than name in those cases. D-route reused Nominatim JSON files captured in the shared work dir by sibling routes (re-read bytes, re-selected venue-class results, recomputed SHA-256; provenance retrieved_at is the file capture time, not D's own fetch time) after its own Nominatim request was stopped by a runtime permission gate; it did not bypass the gate.
